human_stroke_evidence: 11 ischemic stroke autopsies 15 h to 18 d; acute infarct microvessels highly ICAM1-positive up to 97 percent at 1.8 d; a separate six-case autopsy series reported weak endothelial ICAM1
normal_human_vessel_evidence: Human brain endothelial cell-surface endocytosis reported in cultured BBB model with database crosscheck
animal_stroke_access: Anti-ICAM1 iron-oxide antibody particles bound cerebral vessels in mouse post-stroke MRI days 1-3; leukocyte binding appears later
in_vivo_PET_validation: NO_TARGET_SPECIFIC_STROKE_PET_SHOWN_HERE; mouse molecular MRI is not PET
intravascular_epitope_status: PLAUSIBLE_EXTRACELLULAR; human in-vivo luminal epitope and labeled binder access NOT TESTED
biggest_confounds: Systemic inflammation; endothelial adhesion outside CNS; leukocyte ICAM1; altered blood volume flow and BBB permeability

human_stroke_evidence: Six acute ischemic stroke autopsies: infarcted endothelial cells and astrocytes stain intensely; separate intracranial circulating VCAM1 concentrations from 42 thrombectomy patients reflect soluble blood protein not vessel density
normal_human_vessel_evidence: Cell-adhesion protein; extracerebral endothelial expression under inflammation
animal_stroke_access: IV anti-VCAM1 aptamer and antibody-lipid carriers accumulate on mouse stroke vessels; anti-VCAM carrier can deliver cargo in tMCAO models
in_vivo_PET_validation: 18F-4V VCAM1 PET shown in mouse atherosclerotic vessels; NOT cerebral stroke or human PET
intravascular_epitope_status: PRECLINICAL_IN_VIVO_BLOOD_ACCESS; human stroke luminal antibody occupancy NOT MEASURED
biggest_confounds: Human infarct astrocyte signal; soluble VCAM1; generalized inflammation; peripheral endothelial sink; perfusion and BBB-leakage

human_stroke_evidence: Murine ischemic brain CD31+ EC flow cytometry and GLUT1+ vessel fluorescence show CD146 induction at days 1 and 4; this is NOT human stroke vessel protein evidence
normal_human_vessel_evidence: Human brain surgical sections contain CD146-positive pericyte/mural compartments; vascular cell source cannot be assumed endothelial
animal_stroke_access: Protein present on ischemic mouse brain vessels; luminal versus pericytic compartment not resolved by co-staining alone
in_vivo_PET_validation: 89Zr-DFO-YY146 and other anti-CD146 tracers blocked in mice with CD146-positive subcutaneous tumor xenografts; NOT human brain-vessel/stroke PET
biggest_confounds: Pericyte and extracranial vessel expression; antibody large/slow PK; 89Zr residualization; soluble CD146 ligand is NOT a CD146-targeted radiotracer

human_stroke_evidence: CD155 ischemia-induced mouse EC protein by flow cytometry and brain vessel fluorescence; direct human stroke EC protein study not located
normal_human_vessel_evidence: Human non-brain HUVEC endothelial PVR/CD155 participates in leukocyte transmigration; NOT direct human brain stroke vessel mapping
animal_stroke_access: Murine brain vascular CD155 protein demonstrated; blood-facing epitope access after IV ligand unknown
biggest_confounds: Immune TIGIT/CD226 axis binding and possible biological interference; epithelial/tumor and immune background; absent validated stroke tracer

human_stroke_evidence: No direct human poststroke cerebral vessel surface APJ protein shown by reviewed primary sources; 6-sample human surgical EC baseline APLNR RNA detection sparse
normal_human_vessel_evidence: Host APJ PET platform motivated by peripheral hypoxia/angiogenesis models; this is NOT human stroke brain protein
animal_stroke_access: No cerebral ischemia surface binding or brain microvessel PET confirmation in reviewed AP747 studies
in_vivo_PET_validation: 68Ga-AP747 APJ binding and imaging in Matrigel and hindlimb ischemia mouse models, healthy pigs for biodistribution; not brain stroke
biggest_confounds: Low control human EC RNA detection; host tracer peripheral organ receptor/background; flow delivery and BBB lesion leak

human_stroke_evidence: No verified human ischemic brain vascular AMOT protein surface study found; human control cerebral EC AMOT RNA detection low
normal_human_vessel_evidence: Human placenta vascular AMOT protein and endothelial cell expression reported; no proven human BBB luminal accessible epitope
animal_stroke_access: AMOT vascular protein and 68Ga-sCD146 competition/autoradiography shown for mouse hindlimb and infarct heart, not brain
in_vivo_PET_validation: 68Ga-sCD146 binds AMOT in peripheral tissue; do NOT confuse AMOT tracer with membrane MCAM/CD146 targeting
biggest_confounds: AMOT junction-associated/intracellular fractions; isoforms p80/p130; soluble sCD146 pharmacokinetics; BBB leak and nonspecific protein extravasation

human_stroke_evidence: Normal human brain microvessel CD98hc protein supported by mass spectrometry; no ischemic human vessel CD98 surface-change validation
normal_human_vessel_evidence: Human isolated cerebral microvessels and hCMEC/D3 plasma membrane quantitative proteomics identify 4F2hc; 2026 CNS EC enrichment reported
animal_stroke_access: CD98hc antibody transport vehicles enter CNS in humanized mice and cynomolgus monkeys, but NOT ischemic cerebral stroke models
in_vivo_PET_validation: No stroke-specific CD98hc PET tracer test established here; radiolabeled transport vehicle uptake does not equal cargo delivery
biggest_confounds: Normal expression means weak contrast for stroke PET; peripheral kidney/pancreas/spleen sinks; high brain vascular retention may mask parenchymal delivery; transporter physiological function

human_stroke_evidence: Human brain capillary endothelial TfR protein immunohistochemistry is proven outside stroke; no evidence reviewed that stroke increases accessible TfR
normal_human_vessel_evidence: Human capillary TfR localized immunohistochemically; human hCMEC/D3 and brain microvessels protein by proteomics
animal_stroke_access: TfR antibodies and bispecific transports available in animal BBB systems; distribution highly dependent on affinity/valency
in_vivo_PET_validation: No evidence reviewed for TFRC-specific brain-vessel ischemic stroke PET signal; immuno radioactivity may be retained after catabolism
biggest_confounds: Reticulocytes/bone marrow and systemic uptake; serum transferrin competition; receptor degradation; cargo vs vascular adherence; radionuclide residualization

human_stroke_evidence: 15 human stroke patients underwent 18F-THK5351 PET ~3 months after ischemia with perilesional/remote uptake; this signal is not direct vessel immunohistochemistry nor definitively MAO-B-only
normal_human_vessel_evidence: MAO-B typically intracellular on outer mitochondrial membranes of astrocytes and other cells; not a blood-facing vascular receptor
animal_stroke_access: Tracer must enter CNS parenchyma; reversible 18F-SMBT1 ligand has human MAO-B pharmacological blockade support, not verified as stroke PET in cited study
in_vivo_PET_validation: 18F-THK5351 human post-stroke imaging confounded by tau/MAOB and physiologic regional binding; newer 18F-SMBT1 >85% human signal reduction after selegiline in nonstroke participants
biggest_confounds: Tau off-target THK5351; age/MAOB baseline; delivery perfusion and BBB changes; peri-infarct vs core; astrocyte non-exclusive source
